Introducing Saved Views, available today on every paid plan. If you find yourself rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you check on a project, this one's for you. Now you can configure a list exactly how you like it—filtered by assignee, sorted by due date, grouped by priority, whatever fits your workflow—and save it for one-click access later. Each user can save up to 50 views, so there's plenty of room for every project, client, or recurring check-in you track. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to hand a teammate the exact slice of work they need without walking them through setup. Whether you're prepping for a standup, tracking overdue tasks, or keeping an eye on a specific sprint, Saved Views cuts out the repetitive setup and gets you straight to what matters. No configuration required, no admin approval needed—just start saving.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
